nodes.title: Life Orientation
nodes.description: Life Orientation for Grade 8 covering personal wellbeing, social and environmental responsibility, democracy and human rights, physical education, and careers.

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Term 1: Development of the Self; Human Rights and the Law; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Development of the Self in Society
nodes.description: Adolescent development: physical, emotional, cognitive and social changes; influences on identity formation; self-esteem and self-worth; resilience and coping skills; managing change and transition; positive relationships with family and peers. Formal Assessment Task 1: Research task on adolescent development.

nodes.title: Human Rights, Democracy and the Law
nodes.description: Human rights in South Africa and internationally; the relationship between rights and responsibilities; case studies on human rights violations; democratic participation; the role of courts and law in protecting rights; xenophobia and discrimination.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Sport and Movement
nodes.description: Participation in team and individual sports; physical fitness components: strength, endurance, flexibility, speed; warm-up and cool-down routines; sports ethics, fair play and teamwork; health benefits of regular physical activity.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Term 2: Health and Wellbeing; Social and Environmental Responsibility; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Health and Wellbeing — Disease and HIV/AIDS
nodes.description: HIV/AIDS: transmission, prevention, treatment; stigma and discrimination around HIV/AIDS; responsible sexual behaviour; contraception and reproductive health; communicable and non-communicable diseases; mental health and wellbeing. Formal Assessment Task 2: Project on HIV/AIDS awareness.

nodes.title: Social and Environmental Responsibility
nodes.description: Environmental challenges: climate change, water scarcity, deforestation; individual and collective responsibility; community action and activism; global citizenship; sustainable development goals; social entrepreneurship.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Athletics
nodes.description: Athletics: track events (sprints, middle distance), field events (long jump, high jump, shot put); correct technique and form; fitness testing and recording results; setting personal improvement goals.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Term 3: Violence, Abuse and Bullying; Careers and Career Choices; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Violence, Abuse and Bullying
nodes.description: Forms of abuse: physical, emotional, sexual, neglect; gender-based violence; cyberbullying and online safety; reporting abuse and accessing support; assertiveness skills; support networks and counselling services. Formal Assessment Task 3: Awareness campaign on bullying prevention.

nodes.title: Careers and Career Choices
nodes.description: Career exploration: different sectors and industries; education pathways and qualifications; entrepreneurship as a career; financial literacy basics; managing money and budgeting; the future world of work and 4IR.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Gymnastics
nodes.description: Gymnastic movements and sequences; partner and group balancing; rhythmic gymnastics with apparatus; developing coordination, balance and body control; creative movement and expression.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Term 4: Study Skills and Lifelong Learning; Recreational Activities; Physical Education.

nodes.title: Study Skills and Lifelong Learning
nodes.description: Advanced study techniques; exam preparation strategies; managing academic pressure and stress; growth mindset and motivation; setting SMART goals; reflection on personal progress and learning. Formal Assessment Task 4: Portfolio and test.

nodes.title: Recreational Activities and Sport
nodes.description: Benefits of sport and recreational activities; participating in different leisure activities; organising and leading recreational activities; community sport and recreation facilities; promoting active and healthy lifestyles.

nodes.title: Physical Education — Invasion Games
nodes.description: Invasion games: soccer, basketball, netball, rugby; tactics and strategies; rules and officiating; teamwork, communication and leadership; consolidation of physical education fitness concepts for the year.
